press_references.value: Arcjet Introduces Advanced Bot Signals to Stop Modern Browser Automation Without CAPTCHAs

product_launches.description: Arcjet launched Advanced Bot Signals, a new capability in its runtime security platform that uses browser telemetry combined with application context to detect and block modern browser automation and bot abuse without CAPTCHAs, especially for sensitive flows such as signup, login, checkout, forms, and high-cost AI actions.

press_references.value: Arcjet Introduces Guards, Bringing Application Security Inside AI Agent Workflows

product_launches.description: Arcjet launched Guards, an application-layer security capability that enforces security policies inside AI agent workflows, tool calls, queues, and other non-HTTP code paths, extending its runtime security model beyond traditional HTTP boundaries.

press_references.value: Arcjet Introduces AI Prompt Injection Protection to Secure Production AI Endpoints

product_launches.description: Arcjet launched its AI Prompt Injection Protection capability, an inline enforcement feature that detects and blocks hostile prompts at the application boundary before they reach production AI models.

press_references.value: Arcjet reaches v1.0, promises stable security for JavaScript apps

product_launches.description: Arcjet released version 1.0 of its JavaScript SDK, graduating it from alpha/beta to a stable, production-ready security API for JavaScript and TypeScript applications.

press_references.value: Arcjet Launches Python SDK to Bring Application-Layer Security to Python Services and APIs

product_launches.description: Arcjet released a new open-source Python SDK that extends its application-layer security platform to Python-based services and APIs, enabling in-code bot protection, rate limiting, and abuse prevention.

press_references.value: Arcjet Expands Framework Support with Native Nuxt and React Router SDKs

product_launches.description: Arcjet launched a native Nuxt SDK (@arcjet/nuxt) enabling Vue developers to embed code-level security such as bot protection, rate limiting, Shield WAF, email validation, and PII detection using Nuxt-native patterns.

press_references.value: Arcjet Raises $8.3m to Tackle Surge in AI-Powered Cyberattacks and Malicious Bots with In-Code Defense

product_launches.description: Arcjet launched a new local attack detection model that embeds AI threat analysis directly into application code, inspecting each request in real time to block sophisticated bot and fraud activity.

overview_description.description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships with your AI code. Stop bots and automated attacks from burning your AI budget, leaking data, or misusing tools with Arcjet's AI security building blocks.

product.name: Arcjet Security Platform
product.description: A developer-oriented runtime security platform for adding application protection features such as bot detection, rate limiting, email validation, and form spam prevention through code.

product.name: Bot Detection
product.description: A service that identifies and helps block automated or malicious bot activity interacting with web applications and APIs.

product.name: Rate Limiting
product.description: A request-control service that limits how frequently users, clients, or applications can access web endpoints and APIs.

product.name: Email Validation
product.description: A service for checking email addresses submitted to applications to help identify invalid or undesirable addresses.

product.name: Form Spam Prevention
product.description: A service that detects and helps prevent spam submissions to web forms and other user-input endpoints.
